Attached: 1 image

Moving a branch to a commit far away in the graph shouldn’t be a chore.

In SmartGit’s Standard window you can now drag and drop branches between the Graph and the branches list. While dragging a branch, hover over another branch to reveal it in the Graph, which makes it easier to reach a commit farther away.

Available in the SmartGit 26.2 Preview. What’s your least favorite Git task to do with the mouse or keyboard?

👉 https://www.smartgit.dev/whats-new/26_2
